workloads.hara_source: (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 5000) (recur (+ i 1) (+ acc (mod i 17))) acc))
workloads.scheme_source: (let loop ((i 0) (acc 0)) (if (< i 5000) (loop (+ i 1) (+ acc (modulo i 17))) acc))

workloads.hara_source: (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 2500) (recur (+ i 1) ((fn [x] (+ x 1)) acc)) acc))
workloads.scheme_source: (let ((inc (lambda (x) (+ x 1)))) (let loop ((i 0) (acc 0)) (if (< i 2500) (loop (+ i 1) (inc acc)) acc)))

workloads.hara_source: (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 500) (recur (+ i 1) (+ acc (nth [1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8] (mod i 8)))) acc))
workloads.scheme_source: (let ((v (vector 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8))) (let loop ((i 0) (acc 0)) (if (< i 500) (loop (+ i 1) (+ acc (vector-ref v (modulo i 8)))) acc)))
workloads.cl_source: (let ((v (vector 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8))) (do ((i 0 (1+ i)) (acc 0 (+ acc (aref v (mod i 8))))) ((>= i 500) acc)))

workloads.hara_source: (loop [i 0 value {}] (if (< i 500) (recur (+ i 1) (assoc value i (+ i 1))) (get value 499)))
workloads.scheme_source: (let ((h (make-eqv-hashtable))) (let loop ((i 0)) (if (< i 500) (begin (hashtable-set! h i (+ i 1)) (loop (+ i 1))) (hashtable-ref h 499 #f))))
workloads.cl_source: (let ((h (make-hash-table))) (do ((i 0 (1+ i))) ((>= i 500) (gethash 499 h)) (setf (gethash i h) (+ i 1))))
